theme_central: The earth itself will testify, inspired by its Lord — and every deed, even the weight of an atom, will be seen.
sources_note: Universally known content, no possible divergence.

branches.title: The earthquake
branches.resume: The earth trembles, casts out its burdens, man wonders.

children.t: Earthquake, burdens cast out, man's astonishment

branches.title: The earth testifies
branches.resume: That day the earth will tell its story, inspired by its Lord.

children.t: The earth testifies, inspired by its Lord

branches.title: Every deed seen
branches.resume: Mankind comes forth in scattered groups; whoever does an atom's weight of good or evil will see it.

children.t: Every deed, even an atom's weight, will be seen
